text: 据上交所数据，2026年9月A股新开户191.19万户，同比去年9月293.72万户下降35.0%；2026年前9个月已累计新开2712.59万户，同比增长35.0%。
text_en: According to Shanghai Stock Exchange data, 1.9119 million new A-share accounts were opened in September 2026, down 35.0% from 2.9372 million in September last year; in the first nine months of 2026, a cumulative 27.1259 million new accounts were opened, up 35.0% year on year.
